Parliament Disrupted by Opposition Protests Demanding Home Minister's Statement

Both the Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha proceedings were disrupted and adjourned multiple times due to protests by opposition parties. The opposition demanded a statement from Home Minister Amit Shah regarding alleged police action against students. Rajya Sabha Chairman Jagdeep Dhankhar reportedly asked Minister Kiren Rijiju to convey the opposition's sentiments to the Home Minister. In the Lok Sabha, Speaker Om Birla expressed displeasure over the disruptions. The Rajya Sabha also cleared a bill to appropriate Rs 54,067 crore for excess expenditure in 2022-23.
